text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That fishing pond over there
gets way too much sun~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
choice_data_list: Let's take proper care of it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean...
no napping outside or fishing—
choice_data_list: Gotta tough it out for a bit.
You'll have to endure it for a little while.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I don't know whether to miss the sun
or resent it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That day, Seiun Sky repeatedly looked up at the sun
with a bitter, resentful glare."
